alexander-space-time-deity-vol-1-1920.title: Space, Time, and Deity, Vol. 1
alexander-space-time-deity-vol-1-1920.creator: Samuel Alexander
alexander-space-time-deity-vol-1-1920.description: The Gifford lectures: emergent evolution as metaphysics; deity as the universe's nisus. Internet Archive edition.

arxiv-2006-11635.title: COVID-19 in Mexico: A Network of Epidemics
arxiv-2006-11635.creator: Guillermo de Anda-Jáuregui 1,2
arxiv-2006-11635.description: Abstract Abstract Mexico, like the rest of the world, is currently facing the The COVID-19 pandemic. Given the size of its territory, the efforts to contain the disease have involved both national and regional measures. For this work, the curves of daily new cases of each municipality reported by the federal government were compared.

arxiv-2201-00526.title: On coherence of quantum operations by using Choi-Jamiołkowski isomorphism
arxiv-2201-00526.creator: Xiaorong Wang 1 , Ting Gao 1, Fengli Yan 2
arxiv-2201-00526.description: Abstract In quantum information, most information processing processes involve quantum channels. One manifestation of a quantum channel is quantum operation acting on quantum states. The coherence of quantum operations can be considered as a quantum resource, which can be exploited to perform certain quantum tasks.

arxiv-2510-24482.title: Sample-efficient and Scalable Exploration in Continuous-Time RL
arxiv-2510-24482.creator: Klemens Iten, Lenart Treven, Bhavya Sukhija, Florian Dörfler, Andreas Krause
arxiv-2510-24482.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning algorithms are typically designed for discrete-time dynamics, even though the underlying real-world control systems are often continuous in time. In this paper, we study the problem of continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the unknown system dynamics are represented using nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs).

arxiv-2601-09411.title: On the distribution of shapes of sextic pure number fields
arxiv-2601-09411.creator: Anuj Jakhar, Ravi Kalwaniya, Anwesh Ray, Bidisha Roy
arxiv-2601-09411.description: Abstract . The shape of a number field K K of degree n n is defined as the equivalence class of the lattice of integers with respect to linear operations that are composites of rotations, reflections, and positive scalar dilations.

arxiv-2602-21304.title: A Čech–Stokes Pushout Groupoid: A Log/Kummer Betti Presenter for Stokes Torsors
arxiv-2602-21304.creator: Mauricio Corrêa
arxiv-2602-21304.description: Abstract . Let X X be a complex manifold and D ⊂ X D\subset X a simple normal crossings divisor. Fix a Kummer level n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 and an irregular type Φ \Phi along D D , and consider the logarithmic Betti boundary X n log X_{n}^{\log} (the level- n n Kato–Nakayama space).

arxiv-2603-06768.creator: Muhammad Muneeb, David B. Ascher, YooChan Myung, Samuel F. Feng, Andreas Henschel

europmc-pmc3812019.title: Emergence of azole-resistant aspergillus fumigatus strains due to agricultural azole use creates an increasing threat to human health.
europmc-pmc3812019.creator: Chowdhary A, Kathuria S, Xu J, Meis JF.

pmc-10580139.title: Usability of Augmented Reality Technology in Situational Telementorship for Managing Clinical Scenarios: Quasi-Experimental Study
pmc-10580139.creator: Dung T Bui, Tony Barnett, Ha Hoang, Winyu Chinthammit, Tiffany Leung, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Behrus Puladi, Rocío Martín Valero
pmc-10580139.description: BackgroundTelementorship provides a way to maintain the professional skills of isolated rural health care workers. The incorporation of augmented reality (AR) technology into telementoring systems could be used to mentor health care professionals remotely under different clinical situations.ObjectiveThis study aims to evaluate the usability of AR technology in telementorship for managing clinical scenarios in a simulation laboratory.

pmc-10615604.title: Ultrasonic Bone Scalpel versus Conventional Technique for Thoracolumbar Spinal Decompression: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-10615604.creator: Chok-anan Rittipoldech, Pawat Limsomwong, Napatpong Thamrongskulsiri
pmc-10615604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Objective The purpose of the present study is to compare intraoperative blood loss, operating time, laminectomy time, hospital length of stay, and complications in thoracolumbar spinal decompression using ultrasonic bone scalpels (UBSs) with conventional procedures.

pmc-10674296.title: Imipramine Administration in Brucella abortus 2308-Infected Mice Restores Hippocampal Serotonin Levels, Muscle Strength, and Mood, and Decreases Spleen CFU Count
pmc-10674296.creator: José Luis Maldonado-García, Gilberto Pérez-Sánchez, Enrique Becerril-Villanueva, Samantha Alvarez-Herrera, Lenin Pavón, Luvia Sánchez-Torres, Gabriel Gutiérrez-Ospina, Manuel Iván Girón-Pérez, Gabriela Damian-Morales, Jesús Octavio Maldonado-Tapia, Rubén López-Santiago, Martha C. Moreno-Lafont
pmc-10674296.description: Brucellosis infection causes non-specific symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headaches, myalgia, arthralgia, anorexia, fatigue, and mood disorders. In mouse models, it has been associated with increased levels of IL-6, TNF-α, and IFN-γ, a decrease in serotonin and dopamine levels within the hippocampus, induced loss of muscle strength and equilibrium, and increased anxiety and hopelessness.

pmc-11325854.title: Intensive physical activity following total hip arthroplasty increased the revision risk after 15 years: a cohort study of 973 patients from the Geneva Arthroplasty Register
pmc-11325854.creator: Elena ZABALLA, Stefania D’ANGELO, Christophe BAREA, Georgia NTANI, Didier HANNOUCHE, Cyrus COOPER, Anne LÜBBEKE, Karen WALKER-BONE
pmc-11325854.description: Background and purposeYounger recipients of total hip arthroplasty (THA) highly prioritize returning to preoperative levels of physical activity (PA). Surgeons have tended to give cautious advice concerning high-impact sports participation, but there have been few long-term studies. The purpose of our study was to investigate the risk of revision arthroplasty in relation to postoperative PA levels.

pmc-11370063.title: Ginsenoside Rh2 suppresses ferroptosis in ulcerative colitis by targeting specific protein 1 by upregulating microRNA-125a-5p
pmc-11370063.creator: Xun Zhao, WenQiang Yuan, LiuChan Yang, Fang Yan, DeJun Cui
pmc-11370063.description: BackgroundWorldwide, ulcerative colitis (UC) is becoming increasingly fast growing. Ginsenoside Rh2 has been reported to alleviate UC. However, the latent biological mechanism of Rh2 in the treatment of UC remains uncertain. In this study, the goal was to determine the therapeutic effect of Rh2 on dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced UC.

pmc-11430109.title: Integrating randomized controlled trials and non-randomized studies of interventions to assess the effect of rare events: a Bayesian re-analysis of two meta-analyses
pmc-11430109.creator: Yun Zhou, Minghong Yao, Fan Mei, Yu Ma, Jiayidaer Huan, Kang Zou, Ling Li, Xin Sun
pmc-11430109.description: BackgroundThere is a growing trend to include non-randomised studies of interventions (NRSIs) in rare events meta-analyses of randomised controlled trials (RCTs) to complement the evidence from the latter. An important consideration when combining RCTs and NRSIs is how to address potential bias and down-weighting of NRSIs in the pooled estimates.

pmc-11442993.title: SIRPα engagement regulates ILC2 effector function and alleviates airway hyperreactivity via modulating energy metabolism
pmc-11442993.creator: Yoshihiro Sakano, Kei Sakano, Benjamin P Hurrell, Pedram Shafiei-Jahani, Mohammad Hossein Kazemi, Xin Li, Stephen Shen, Richard Barbers, Omid Akbari
pmc-11442993.description: Group-2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2) are part of a growing family of innate lymphocytes known for their crucial role in both the development and exacerbation of allergic asthma. The activation and function of ILC2s are regulated by various activating and inhibitory molecules, with their balance determining the severity of allergic responses.

pmc-11621651.title: Association of Uterine Leiomyoma with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Young Women: A Population-Based Cohort Study
pmc-11621651.creator: Ji-Hee Sung, Kyung-Soo Kim, Kyungdo Han, Cheol-Young Park
pmc-11621651.description: BackgroundWe investigated the association between uterine leiomyoma (UL) and incident type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in young women.MethodsA nationwide population-based cohort study of 2,541,550 women aged between 20 and 40 years was performed using the National Health Information Database. Cox proportional hazards models were used to analyze the risk of incident T2DM according to the presence of UL and myomectomy.

pmc-11622359.title: Challenges for Antepartum Care of the Individual with Perinatal Substance Use: An Empirical Integrative Review of Novel Approaches to Improve Care
pmc-11622359.creator: Lauren Taylor Narbey, Alice Curtis Cline
pmc-11622359.description: IntroductionPerinatal substance use continues to rise across the United States presenting unique challenges to providing antepartum care. Polysubstance use, limited and late engagement in health care, co‐occurring mood disorders, and several social barriers are well documented. This review seeks to summarize these barriers and present novel approaches to caring for this high‐risk population.

pmc-11677652.title: Abnormalities of IL-12 Family Cytokine Pathways in Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease Progression
pmc-11677652.creator: Corina-Daniela Ene, Ilinca Nicolae, Cristina Căpușă, Lorena Losi
pmc-11677652.description: Background and Objectives: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) is the most frequent genetic renal disease with a complex physiopathology. More and more studies sustain that inflammation plays a crucial role in ADPKD pathogenesis and progression. We evaluated IL-12 involvement in ADPKD pathophysiology by assessing the serum levels of its monomers and heterodimers.

pmc-12404956.title: Quantitative histopathologic profiling of arterial dissection-related thrombi in acute ischemic stroke: etiological comparisons
pmc-12404956.creator: Gang Cai, XuMing Fang, Jun Li, YuanHua Cheng, YanHui Zhang, Lan Chu
pmc-12404956.description: IntroductionArterial dissection is an important etiology of stroke in young adults and may demonstrate distinct thrombus characteristics. While most studies have focused on compositional differences between cardioembolic (CE) and non-cardioembolic thrombi, systematic analyses of dissection-related thrombi remain scarce. This study characterized the compositions of dissection thrombi, compared them with those of non-dissection thrombi, and explored compositional variations among stroke etiologies.

pmc-12419679.title: Select and reject conditional control on matching to sample and stimulus equivalence
pmc-12419679.creator: Elberto A Plazas, Juan Carlos Forigua
pmc-12419679.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The purpose of this study was to test Carrigan and Sidman's (1992) hypothesis that the emergence of equivalence relations from the standard matching‐to‐sample (MTS) procedure is due to the exclusive acquisition of select conditional relations during training.

pmc-12431945.title: The application of robotic and artificial intelligence technologies in spinal surgery: a review focused on prospects in remote areas of China
pmc-12431945.creator: Zhibin Liu, Junlong Huang, Hao Zhang, Shuzhuo Zhang, Honghao Dai, Yuexin Jiang, Hongtao Bi, Zhongshu Shan
pmc-12431945.description: Spinal surgery in remote regions of China, including high-altitude plateau areas, faces unique challenges due to limited medical resources, harsh environmental conditions, and shortages of specialized expertise. Robotic spinal surgery and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies offer promising solutions to enhance diagnostic accuracy and support surgical decision-making in these underserved settings.

pmc-12464200.title: Advancing real-time validation of automotive software systems via continuous integration and intelligent failure analysis
pmc-12464200.creator: Mohammad Abboush, Christoph Knieke, Andreas Rausch
pmc-12464200.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In the automotive industry, a rigorous testing process based on ISO 26,262 is carried out at various stages of the V-model to ensure the quality of software systems. Conventional validation of embedded electronic control units (ECUs) using hardware-in- the-loop (HIL) testing is performed in the late stages using the big bang integration style, resulting in delayed feedback, lack of scalability, and insufficient fault diagnosis.

pmc-13260647.title: Which explainable AI methods in medical imaging are clinically impactful? A systematic literature review addressing the clinician's perspective
pmc-13260647.creator: Shahab Ud Din, Ruby Kemna, Johannes C. F. Ket, Muhammad Iqbal, Omar Bohoudi, Mark Hoogendoorn, Elena Beretta, Aneta Lisowska
pmc-13260647.description: BackgroundExplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has emerged as a strategy to enhance the transparency and interpretability of AI systems in medical imaging. Although numerous methods have been developed to generate explanations of model behavior, their evaluation has predominantly relied on technical performance metrics rather than clinician-centered assessment.

pmc-13625679.title: EBA-related body-preferring responses in the occipitotemporal cortex measured with functional near-infrared spectroscopy
pmc-13625679.creator: Yuanchun Liu, Qiuya Zhao, Jiayu Wu, Ping Yang, Yuannong Ye, Min Wang
pmc-13625679.description: BackgroundThe extrastriate body area (EBA) is involved in the visual processing of bodies and body parts, but most evidence for its response profile comes from fMRI. We examined whether fNIRS can detect body-preferring occipitotemporal responses consistent with EBA-related processing.MethodsSixty university students passively viewed non-hand body parts, hands, and objects.

pmc-13627206.creator: Carlo Lai, Emanuele Giraldi, Teresa Paolucci, Alice Cichelli, Sofia Mazzani, Stefano Delli Pizzi, Giorgio Veneziani
